description: “AI University is the first dream for which we started working. We already set up the task force. In the next two-three months the policy is expected to come."
body_lead: Maharashtra government is set to unveil its dedicated Artificial Intelligence (AI) University policy in the coming month, marking a significant shift in the state’s digital governance and education landscape. The proposed institution, backed by the Higher and Technical Education Department and Mumbai University, is envisioned as a specialized platform to build capacity in AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation. Ashish Shelar, Minister for Information Technology and Cultural Affairs, Government of Maharashtra, confirmed the development during a recent interaction with ETGovernment.
